title: Canal Road Night Bazaar
summary: Stalls for street food and household goods along Canal Road. Entry is free.
description: A Friday evening row of stalls on Canal Road. Reserve a free place if you want the meeting point and the start time saved. Food is paid at the stalls. This is a sample listing.

tickets.name: Free entry
tickets.detail: A reminder and a meeting point. Food is paid at stalls.

title: Chenab Kitchen Pop-up
summary: One seating tonight at Lyallpur Galleria. A short demo menu, grilled and shared.
description: Twenty-four seats for a single sitting in the Galleria atrium. The menu is fictional for this demo: seekh, daal, and a seasonal drink. Arrive by 6:45 PM. Sample listing.
goodToKnow: No payment is taken in this demo

tickets.name: Supper seat
tickets.detail: One person, 7:00 PM sitting.

title: Clock Tower Morning Walk
summary: Ninety minutes from Ghanta Ghar toward Rail Bazaar, while the streets are still quiet.
description: The group meets on the Clock Tower lawn at 7:00 AM and walks toward Rail Bazaar. Bring a phone or a camera if you want to look properly. The route is flat. Sample listing, capped at forty people.
goodToKnow: Wear shoes you can walk in

tickets.name: Walker
tickets.detail: One place on the Saturday walk.

title: Lyallpur Food & Culture Festival
summary: Two days on the D-Ground lawn: home kitchens, a short evening set, and stalls for local crafts.
description: A sample weekend on D-Ground. Kitchens from around the city cook through the afternoon, and a small stage runs after 6:00 PM. Craft stalls line the Civil Lines edge of the ground. This is not a municipal festival; it is a demo listing.
goodToKnow: Children enter on an adult ticket

tickets.name: Lawn
tickets.detail: One person, one day on the ground.

tickets.name: Table for four
tickets.detail: One day. The table holds four.

tickets.name: Weekend pass
tickets.detail: One person, both days.

title: Sunday Textile Workshop
summary: A materials afternoon on Chen One Road. Cloth, blades, and colour are on the table.
description: Eight seats in the Chen One Exhibition Hall. You leave with a small cotton piece you cut and coloured yourself. Materials are included in the ticket. Sample listing for a Sunday workshop.

tickets.name: Maker seat
tickets.detail: One seat. Tools stay in the hall.

title: Danyal Zafar & Zoha Waseem Live in Faisalabad
summary: Live concert in Faisalabad. Early bird tickets from PKR 3,500. Doors at 6:00 PM on 4 October.
description: Zoha Waseem and Danyal Zafar on one bill, billed as a live concert in Faisalabad. The poster marks an early bird discount. The ticket on this desk starts at PKR 3,500.

tickets.name: Early bird
tickets.detail: The discount printed on the concert poster.

title: The Spotlight Show
summary: Golden Bowl presents The Spotlight Show. Red carpet at 7:00 PM, show until 10:00 PM. Early bird from PKR 1,000.
description: An evening at Golden Bowl on East Canal Road. The red carpet is at 7:00 PM and the show runs through 10:00 PM on 17 October. Early bird tickets start at PKR 1,000.

tickets.name: Early bird
tickets.detail: One seat. Red carpet at 7:00 PM.

title: Faisalabad Comedy Night
summary: A seated comedy bill at Kohinoor City. One stage, one sitting, from PKR 1,200.
description: Short sets on a proper stage, in the same spirit as the live shows already on the desk. Doors at 7:30 PM, first set at 8:00 PM. One ticket is one seat.

tickets.name: Seat
tickets.detail: One seat for the evening.

title: Lyallpur Maker Room
summary: An afternoon maker room on Chen One Road. Tools are on the table. From PKR 900.
description: A working afternoon for people who want to make something with their hands. Cutters, cloth, and a bench are included. You leave with the piece you made. About three hours.

tickets.name: Bench
tickets.detail: One place at the table. Tools stay in the room.

title: Canal Road Night Out
summary: A city gathering on the Canal Road stage. Doors at 8:00 PM. From PKR 800.
description: An evening gathering beside Canal Road, built like the other live nights on this desk: one stage, a standing ticket, and room at the front. Music from 8:30 PM.

tickets.name: Standing
tickets.detail: General entry on the canal side.

title: University Design Talks
summary: Three short student presentations and one working designer, off Susan Road.
description: A free afternoon in the Susan Road Lecture Theatre. This demo is not an official university programme. Doors open at 2:40 PM. Seats are first come on the day, and the reservation holds a place.

tickets.name: Free seat
tickets.detail: One seat in the lecture theatre.

title: Faisalabad Startup Meetup
summary: Five short talks, then open tables, for people building something in Faisalabad.
description: A sample meetup near Susan Road. Speakers get eight minutes. After that the room breaks into tables: hiring, first customers, and workshops you can actually run in the city. Not affiliated with a named accelerator.
goodToKnow: Stay for the tables or leave after the talks

tickets.name: Attendee
tickets.detail: Talks and a place at the tables.

title: Founders Breakfast
summary: Eight seats at Kohinoor City. One topic: first customers in Faisalabad.
description: A paid breakfast with a small table, not a conference. The conversation is moderated and ends by 10:00 AM. Sample listing. The hall is inside Kohinoor City.

tickets.name: Chair
tickets.detail: One seat at the table.

title: Inter-College Cricket Showcase
summary: Short matches on the D-Ground sports field. A spectator ticket for the afternoon.
description: A friendly sample fixture, not a board match and not at Iqbal Stadium. Play starts at 2:00 PM on the D-Ground field. The ticket is for watching from the lawn.

tickets.name: Spectator
tickets.detail: Lawn viewing for one person.

title: Ghanta Ghar Family Fair
summary: A Sunday fair beside the Clock Tower: food stalls, a story tent, and room to sit.
description: This sample date is sold out. The fair runs beside Ghanta Ghar from 4:00 PM, aimed at families with young children. When a later date is added it will show here.

tickets.name: Adult
tickets.detail: One adult.

tickets.name: Child
tickets.detail: Ages 4 to 12.

title: Faisalabad Creative Expo
summary: Illustration, textile prints, and small studios showing work inside Lyallpur Galleria.
description: A three-day sample exhibition in the Galleria atrium. Studios from Faisalabad hang work and sell small prints. Short talks sit in a side room at 4:00 PM each day. Demo listing.
goodToKnow: Prints are priced by the studios

tickets.name: Day pass
tickets.detail: One person, one day.

tickets.name: Three-day pass
tickets.detail: One person, all three days.

title: Sunday Story Hour
summary: Picture books for children aged 4 to 8, read aloud inside Lyallpur Galleria.
description: A parent stays with the child. The hour is read in Urdu and English, half and half. Seats are cushions on the atrium floor. Sample listing.

tickets.name: Child and parent
tickets.detail: One child. One adult comes along.

title: Faisalabad Business Summit
summary: A one-day sample programme at Kohinoor City for owners of mills, shops, and service firms.
description: Morning briefings on hiring and export paperwork, then afternoon meetings you book inside the hall. This is a demo listing. It is not a chamber of commerce event and not affiliated with a named company.

tickets.name: Delegate
tickets.detail: Full day for one person.

tickets.name: Firm table
tickets.detail: Three seats from one company.

title: Export Readiness Clinic
summary: Documents, packing, and a checklist for firms sending samples out of Faisalabad.
description: A practical sample workshop on Chen One Road. You bring one product you already make. The session walks through paperwork and how a sample should be packed. Not a government clinic.

tickets.name: Clinic seat
tickets.detail: One person and a workbook.

title: Canal Futsal Evening
summary: Pickup games on a Canal Road court. The ticket holds a player spot.
description: A sample evening of short games. Boots or trainers with grip are enough. The court is a demo location along Canal Road, not a named club. Teams are made on the night.
goodToKnow: Player ticket, not a spectator seat

tickets.name: Player
tickets.detail: One spot in the pickup games.
